description.message: Paste clipboard text into editable fields by simulating human typing.

startIntro.message: Types your clipboard text into a field, one key at a time. Use it where normal paste does not work.

step1Sub.message: Copy from any app or page.

step2Sub.message: An input, a text area, or any editable area.

step3Sub.message: Click the toolbar icon, press the shortcut, or right-click the field and select Paste as Typing.

privacy.message: Your text stays on this device

privacySub.message: The extension reads the clipboard only when you start it. It does not upload or store your text.

pinRowSub.message: Open the extensions menu in the toolbar, then pin Smart Paste Typing for one-click use.

practiceHint.message: Copy the sample text, click the field, then press your shortcut or select Type from clipboard.

sampleText.message: Hello! Smart Paste Typing typed this text, one key at a time.

statusCopyFailed.message: Could not copy. Copy some text by hand.

statusEmpty.message: Your clipboard has no text. Copy some text first.

speedRowSub.message: A random delay between each key press.

badgeRowSub.message: Shows the live character count on the toolbar icon while typing.

stopRowSub.message: Use the shortcut, menu, or icon again while typing to stop.
